summary: A self-restart that has durably reached its quiet boundary no longer reports its planned mailbox disconnect as a lost channel. A self-restart still waiting for quiet continues to report genuine channel loss.

schema.detail: No schema change; classification reads the existing request-scoped quiescence record.

rules.detail: Mailbox loss is suppressed for restart-when-idle only after that request's durable quiescence record exists, for the same incarnation and before restart completion. Direct restart behavior is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire or persisted format changes. Older hosts may still report planned self-restart disconnects as channel-loss faults.

downtime.detail: No downtime required by this change.

manual.detail: No clearing or replay is required for historical faults from replaced incarnations; current health and attention already exclude them.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the previous classification. Native replay proof requirements for actual channel-loss recovery are unchanged.
